client.thinkingHandling: Disable thinking. Qwen3.6 thinks by default (model card: 'Qwen3.6 models operate in thinking mode by default ... <think>...</think>'; non-thinking via chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking: false}; /think and /nothink soft switches are NOT supported). The GGUF's embedded chat_template (HF API gguf.chat_template, 8057 chars) contains both 'enable_thinking' and '<think>'. With the shipped client's max_tokens 1024 and a json_schema grammar, a thinking pass would eat the budget and risk truncation, so run with thinking off: server-side LLAMA_ARG_REASONING=off AND per-request chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking:false} from the shim. No reasoning_content handling is then needed; the client reads choices[0].message.content. Use temperature 0 as shipped. Note Qwen's recommended non-thinking sampling is temperature 0.7/top_p 0.8/top_k 20/presence_penalty 1.5; greedy deviates from that, so watch for repetition loops, which max_tokens 1024 bounds.

Issue #27792 (open): CUDA MMQ mul_mat_id (MoE) src1_q8_1 tail padding computed from ne11==1 gives an out-of-bounds read and sporadic 'illegal memory access' for some ubatch sizes. Reported on sm_120 with host-resident experts (--cpu-moe); the reporter says the buffer math is model-independent for any MoE on the MMQ mul_mat_id path. Our recipe keeps all experts on GPU (no --cpu-moe), which is the reported trigger, so exposure is lower but not zero. UBATCH_SIZE 512 is the default; if an 'illegal memory access' shows up, try UBATCH_SIZE 508/1024 only as a diagnostic.

Issue #23210 (open): 'llama-server crashes on CUDA with Qwen3.6-27B' - silent crash / GPU hang (Xid 8, 'launch timed out') on long prefill with --flash-attn on and q8_0 KV. Mostly reported with draft-mtp and multi-GPU tensor split on RTX 50-series, and a 2026-08-10 comment says a multi-GPU sync fix was found, and driver 610 fixed one reporter. A 2026-07-11 comment reports hard host freezes during large-prompt prefill on the qwen35moe Qwen3.6-35B-A3B hybrid arch (Gated DeltaNet + periodic full-attention) on sm_86 with both q4_0 and f16 KV, implicating the chunked GDN prefill path, with failure probability rising with prefill size (4.4k-26k tokens). The reporter linked #22450 (closed stale, never fixed). Our workload is single GPU, no MTP, no tensor split, per-request prompts up to ~12K+ tokens, so this class of bug is the main thing to watch. It is NOT Blackwell-specific and q8_0 KV is not required to trigger it (f16 froze too).
